up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for multiple myeloma. Return the ChEMBL ID, molecule name, canonical SMILES, indication details (mesh_id and mesh_heading), and the maximum clinical phase for that indication.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.mesh_id,
  di.mesh_heading,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE di.mesh_heading = 'Multiple Myeloma'
  AND md.max_phase = 4;
